title: Armstrong's habits on the road and the Louis and Lil stage act
summary: Armstrong did not jam after work but went to bed; Randolph praises the immaculate comic act of Louis and Lil in a New Orleans theater.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, did Louis do any jamming when he was down there, that you know of? Earl Hines told me that when they were playing together in Chicago with the Sunset, I guess this was in '27, '28, that Louis always kept his mouthpiece in his pocket, and he and Earl would go out after they got through and sit in every place.
Did Louis continue that on the road?
No, he didn't do any of that, no. No, because Louis worked so devilish hard, when he got through, he'd go and hit the sack.
Yeah, he'd hit the sack. No, he didn't do that.
Did you ever do any small band things, you know, on gigs like just trumpet, clarinet and trombone and a rhythm section, do any of the old tunes, or fake some things?

No. He would always do the band. I'll tell you one thing that I saw down there. They had a little program, a little show -- this was in the theatre, because this was entertaining the blacks. And I saw Louis and this -- I'll say his first wife, I guess, Lil -- I guess you know Lil.

Uh-huh. Well, Louis and Lil put on an act, honest to goodness, I had never seen such a superb act. That act was immaculate. Those two people performed. I didn't know -- they looked like they could just breathe together. They knew what one another was doing, and I said to myself, "It's a shame that she's not in some kind of a show."

Well, they said she was a good dancer. But she didn't do too much dancing, but just the witty little things that she and Louis would do. And she would sing, Louis would play the horn. Then, they would start ribbing one another and kidding one another on the show. And their act was -- the band enjoyed it more so than the people did.
Well, Lil was in New Orleans with Louis?
With Louis, yeah. She was in New Orleans with Louis.
Did she travel on the one-nighters with him?
Yeah, she travelled some with us. Not all the time, but a lot of times she travelled with us.
Yeah. She was quite a lady.
